prompt: A yellow (14) `Z` (`0x5A`) on a red (4) background is written at row 5, column 20 of the 80 by 25 text screen at `0xB8000`.

trace.label: [address] of the first byte of the cell
[value] written to port `0x3D5` after selecting index `0x0E` (cursor high byte), cursor at that cell
[column] after `\t` when the cursor is at column 13

explain: The character is the low byte and the attribute the high byte of the 16-bit cell, so yellow on red is 14 | (4 << 4) = 0x4E and the cell is 0x4E5A. Cell index = 5 * 80 + 20 = 420, and each cell is 2 bytes, so the byte offset is 840 = 0x348, giving 0xB8348. The cursor position is the cell index 420 = 0x01A4: the high byte 0x01 goes to 0x3D5 after index 0x0E, the low byte 0xA4 after index 0x0F. A tab rounds up to the next multiple of 8: (13 + 8) & ~7 = 16.
